title: Validating UTF-8 bytes using only 0.45 cycles per byte (AVX edition)
key_contribution: Demonstrated streaming SIMD validation of UTF-8 using PSHUFB nibble lookup to classify bytes and check state transitions, achieving sub-cycle-per-byte validation.

title: UTF-8 validation flag lookup algorithm (simdjson PR #365)
key_contribution: Introduced the flag-lookup UTF-8 validation algorithm using 3 PSHUFB lookups against high nibbles, directly applicable to Base64 character classification.

title: Base64 Malleability in Practice
key_contribution: Documented security vulnerabilities from non-canonical Base64 encodings, motivating strict validation in decoders to prevent malleable inputs.

title: A Branchless UTF-8 Decoder
key_contribution: Demonstrated fully branchless byte-stream decoding with error detection using bitmask arithmetic, applicable pattern for Base64 validation.
